semiconductor_relevance: High — Wave Photonics specializes in photonic integrated circuit design technology, which is crucial for the development of advanced semiconductor applications.
summary: Wave Photonics is focused on advancing photonic integrated circuit (PIC) design technology to facilitate the mass production and adoption of integrated photonics. Their patent-pending design platform integrates various processes to create process design kits (PDKs) that are applicable across multiple materials and wavelengths, particularly in Co-Packaged Optics and quantum technologies.
capabilities: Design platform for photonic integrated circuits
Process design kits (PDKs) for various materials and wavelengths
Collaboration on Co-Packaged Optics and transceiver technologies
Expertise in quantum applications including quantum key distribution
